4. Use a task list: Write down your tasks for the day on a planner, sticky note, or digital tool. This helps you visualize your tasks and stay on track.

By following these strategies, young professionals can take control of their retirement planning, make informed investment decisions, and work towards achieving their long-term financial objectives.
